	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }

		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			while = {
				limit = {
					prev = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 1 }
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_foundation value >= 1 }
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_body value >= 1 }
					location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_function value >= 1 }

					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_proposal_site value = scope:tv_wonder_priority_site }
					tv_wonder_set_proposal_on_great_engineer_effect = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { prev = { has_variable = tv_wonder_priority_found } }
					NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_final_building_trigger = yes }
					OR = {
						has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_foundation
						has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_body
						has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_function
						has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_decoration
						has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city
					}
				}
				prev = {
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_proposal value = 140 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_proposal_mode value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_found value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_proposal_site value = scope:tv_wonder_priority_site }
					tv_wonder_set_proposal_on_great_engineer_effect = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { prev = { has_variable = tv_wonder_priority_found } }
					OR = {
						AND = {
							location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_inaugurated value >= 1 }
							NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_inaugurated value >= 2 } }
							OR = {
								var:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_scale_tier ?= { this >= 2 }
								NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_scale_tier }
							}
						}
						AND = {
							location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_inaugurated value >= 2 }
							NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_inaugurated value >= 3 } }
							OR = {
								var:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_scale_tier ?= { this >= 3 }
								NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_scale_tier }
							}
						}
						AND = {
							location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_inaugurated value >= 3 }
							NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_inaugurated value >= 4 } }
							OR = {
								var:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_scale_tier ?= { this >= 4 }
								NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_scale_tier }
							}
						}
						AND = {
							location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_inaugurated value >= 4 }
							NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_inaugurated value >= 5 } }
							OR = {
								var:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_scale_tier ?= { this >= 5 }
								NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_scale_tier }
							}
						}
						AND = {
							location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_inaugurated value >= 5 }
							NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_inaugurated value >= 6 } }
							OR = {
								var:tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_scale_tier ?= { this >= 6 }
								NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_unique_jerusalem_holy_city_scale_tier }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				prev = {
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_proposal value = 140 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_proposal_mode value = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_found value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_proposal_site value = scope:tv_wonder_priority_site }
					tv_wonder_set_proposal_on_great_engineer_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
